name: LoupeZoomImage
job: Let visitors inspect product detail through a glass loupe that magnifies the photo under the pointer
visitor_action: hover or drag the loupe over the image; keyboard arrows move it; tap toggles it on touch
mobile: tap toggles the loupe at the tapped spot; tap-and-hold shows it above the finger and it follows the drag
motion: loupe rests tilted on the print with a faint breathing float, picks up with a scale-in pop and follows the pointer with spring lag; glare, fringe and shadow drift with velocity (reduced-motion: no lag, instant moves)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Jeweller's bench: neutral linen backdrop, polished brass rim, glass with curved highlight and faint chromatic fringe at the edge
notes: 2026-11-23: quality redo (Sonnet 5.5). Root cause of 'broken': default Unsplash photo URL returned 404, and the collapsed broken left the stage empty (lens image also dark). Fix: self-contained vector watch shot as default and onError fallback, frame owns the aspect ratio, full-bleed print, 320px brass loupe resting tilted on it. Render/craft gates not run (screenshots disabled); verify in gallery. Default image is a stylised vector, not a photograph; a supplied low-res photo reads soft at high zoom. | 2026-11-23: QA nit fixes. Handle now mirrors toward the side of the frame with room and shortens to fit (--lz-hx/hy/hk set in paint), so it no longer overlaps the x4 chip or clips at the 375 card edge.
